note: September finished at 4,295 bookings against a 3,853 target, +11.5 percent, and 4.1 percent below August. Against last September the portfolio is +15.9 percent. The Chinese Library (+33.2 percent) and Cantina (+33.0 percent) were the furthest ahead of target, and Shiro is up by half on last year, helped by Tai Kwun which did not exist last September. Dim Sum Library is the only venue below target, and it is also below both August and last September, so it is the one venue where the trend is down on every measure. Aqua HK beat its September target by 8.0 percent but is still behind on the financial year line. The fall against August is seasonal and is spread across five of the six venues. Vesu and The Canton Library are excluded; neither has a target set.
